regime_context: The detector shows a clear precious-metals leadership block (Gold Miners rank 1, Silver & Royalties rank 2, both eligible with high breadth) over a broad but two-tier market: 9 of 16 themes eligible, no one-narrative dominance, absorption only 0.31. Gate helps on this market, so trend discipline has meaningful drawdown value here; but cross-sectional momentum is an attention lens only. emerging_watch: Watching whether the precious-metals block (Gold Miners + Silver & Royalties, both eligible with breadth >0.9) sustains its combined relative leadership for two more weeks — the condition that retires this watch is either theme's proxy making a new 20-day low. No handoff yet.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners sit at rank 1 with the highest durability bar (0.66), broadest breadth (0.933), no crowding, and eligibility confirmed by the absolute-trend gate. The trend-gate is the only validated leg here (drawdown control), and it is currently granting eligibility; rank itself is focus, not forecast. I lean in the direction of the leader but keep conviction low because the detector has no return-prediction edge and the previous high-conviction directional record is only 0.372.
theses.dissent: R10 is negative (-0.0054) despite the high rank, and Hurst is 'mixed' — recent trend health is not cleanly persistent, so the leadership may already be stalling at the top.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO gives back more than half its 20-day relative gain vs S&P/TSX before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the confirmed challenger (score 1.627), eligible, uncrowded, and high breadth (0.917), sitting inside the same precious-metals leadership block. The rotation margin over the leader is only 0.173 and there is no confirmed handoff, so this is a companion lean on the dominant theme complex, not a separate call. Gate eligibility supports staying power on this market.
theses.dissent: Silver is a higher-beta precious metal exposure; if the broad precious-metals trade stalls, Silver & Royalties will likely fall harder than Gold Miners and has no independent fundamental anchor from this state.

falsifier.text: Silver & Royalties' proxy lags Gold Miners' proxy by 5% over 10 trading days before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is eligible and rank 3, but its durability bar is the lowest of the eligible leaders (0.51), Hurst is 'mean-revert' (trend is not healthy), and breadth is only 0.667 — leadership is thinner. Crowding z 0.91 is not a fade reason, just a size-down caution at most. The trend-gate is doing the real work here, and with mean-revert texture I am hesitant to lean beyond a soft directional nod.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting Hurst plus the modest durability bar suggests this theme may churn sideways rather than trend, so the overweight lean could produce tracking error without return.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO falls below its 20-day average before the check-by date while the broad market is flat.
